topic: Practical adoption and verification of AI coding agents
audience: Student developers and small software teams who know basic programming and Git but need help evaluating coding-agent claims
central_question: Which recent advances in AI coding agents are useful enough to adopt, and what should developers still verify themselves?
scope: Coding workflows, verification, maintainability, agent permissions, and evidence of developer benefit
exclusions: Investment advice, general AI news without a coding-workflow consequence, rankings without methods, and promotional claims presented as established results
editorial_voice: Practical, curious, skeptical of unsupported claims, and clear about uncertainty
return_value: A recurring evidence-based assessment of what to try, how to evaluate it, and what remains unresolved
